limits: TIFF/TGA input: under 20 MB, at most 16,777,216 pixels. First TIFF image only. No new npm dependencies; TIFF decoding uses UTIF bundled with Three.js.

Classic unsigned 8/16-bit interleaved grayscale/RGB TIFF, 8-bit indexed TIFF; supported compression is uncompressed/LZW/Deflate/PackBits. BigTIFF, floats, CMYK, JPEG TIFF and camera RAW require external conversion.
TGA supports raw/RLE true-color/indexed/grayscale; interleaved scanlines are rejected. TGA 16-bit gray means gray+alpha, not 16-bit height precision.
ICC profiles and gamma metadata are not transformed; use sRGB albedo. Converted material slots are 8-bit PNG; TIFF numeric samples retain source precision until final ORM packing.
Chrome/Windows only. No cross-browser/device certification, maximum-size batch stress test, or exhaustive vendor-format compatibility claim.
